description: This file defines the AppIdentityDbContext class, which inherits from IdentityDbContext. It is used to manage the Entity Framework Core database context for identity-related data such as users in the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContext
classes.description: Represents the Entity Framework Core database context for ASP.NET Core Identity, customized for the application's identity models.

methods.name: AppIdentityDbContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database context with options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the default method to configure the model for the Identity database, allowing further customization if needed.
